label: SLE / LN patients in CAR-T discussions
description: Lupus patients (SLE or UCTD/MCTD) speaking in the CAR-T-for-lupus community thread. Spans the full curiosity-to-eligibility-to-experience arc: the trial enrollee narrating their own treatment, refractory patients considering CAR-T after multiple drug failures, eligibility-blocked patients (cancer history, distance from site, no caregiver support, 'not sick enough'), and onlookers asking practical questions about the process.
